gloss: destination of transmission; recipient; To: address

definitions.gloss: destination of transmission; recipient; To: address
definitions.explanation: The address or party to which an email, fax, or other electronic communication is sent. The label of the To: field on forms and email clients.

examples.japanese: {送信先|そうしんさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{送信先|そうしんさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally sent the email with the wrong recipient name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{送信先|そうしんさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しよう→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: For emails containing personal information, always make sure to verify that the recipient is correct.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{送信|そうしん}→送信：17692_soushin⟧ (transmission) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination). The 〜⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ suffix forms many "destination/contact" words: ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact address), ⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧ (addressee).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送信先|そうしんさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to verify the recipient
- {送信先|そうしんさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose the recipient
- {送信先|そうしんさき}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: recipient unknown / address not found
- {送信先|そうしんさき}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of recipients

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧: addressee — used for postal mail as well as email
- {受信者|じゅしんしゃ}: receiver, recipient — focuses on the person, not the address
- {宛|あて}: addressed to (suffix) — used in formal address lines, e.g. ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{宛|あて}
